title: Pan-Seared Canadian Salmon
description: A simple yet flavorful recipe for seared salmon with a crispy crust. This dish is high in protein and omega-3 fatty acids. Serve with your favorite sides for a delicious and healthy meal.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Add the skillet oil to the preheated skillet. Once hot, add the salmon fillets, skin side up (if they have skin).
Sear the salmon for 2-3 minutes, then flip and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the panko breadcrumbs in a shallow dish.
Once the salmon is cooked, place it on a plate and immediately sprinkle the panko breadcrumbs on top.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
